lede: Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.6 against -0.2, a 7.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Minnesota +1.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan winning 54% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Minnesota leads Michigan by 78 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
